name: Expo
look: Pure white with a sky-blue gradient in the hero only, a black pill CTA, and device mockups as the whole chrome.

hero.title: Build one app, ship to everywhere
hero.sub: React Native with the build pipeline, updates and native modules already solved. Write once, ship to iOS, Android and web from the same codebase.

features.title: Everything between your code and the store
features.sub: The unglamorous parts of shipping a mobile app, handled.

items.title: Cloud builds
items.body: Build signed iOS and Android binaries without owning a Mac or maintaining a signing keychain.

items.title: Over-the-air updates
items.body: Ship a JavaScript fix in under a minute without waiting on review.

items.title: Native modules
items.body: Hundreds of native APIs already wrapped, with an escape hatch to write your own.

items.title: Runs on device instantly
items.body: Scan a code and your app is running on a real phone, with hot reload.

items.title: Preview builds
items.body: Every pull request gets an installable build reviewers can actually tap.

items.title: Store submission
items.body: Automated submission to both stores with credentials managed for you.

showcases.title: Fix it before the review queue
showcases.body: A JavaScript-only change ships as an over-the-air update in under a minute, with staged rollout and instant rollback. Native changes still go through review, and the tooling tells you which kind you have made.
points: Tells you when a change needs a native build

showcases.title: No Mac required
showcases.body: Cloud builds handle signing, provisioning and the whole Xcode toolchain. Credentials are generated and stored for you, or you can bring your own and keep them.
points: Signed iOS builds without a Mac
Credentials managed or bring your own

gallery.title: Documentation
gallery.sub: Getting started, native modules, builds and updates.

testimonial.quote: We shipped a crash fix on a Saturday afternoon and it was on every device before the evening. Previously that was a three-day review and a lot of apologising.
testimonial.name: Tomás Ferreira

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.sub: Free to develop. Pay for build minutes and update bandwidth.

items.q: Do I still need a Mac?
items.a: No. Cloud builds produce signed iOS binaries without one. A Mac is only needed if you want to run the iOS simulator locally.

items.q: What can be shipped over the air?
items.a: Anything JavaScript, including most UI and logic changes. Adding or upgrading a native module needs a new binary, and the CLI tells you which case you are in.

items.q: Can I eject to bare React Native?
items.a: Yes, at any time, and the generated native projects are ordinary Xcode and Gradle projects with no proprietary wrapper.
Generated and encrypted at rest by default, or bring your own and keep them in your own keychain — both paths are fully supported.

cta.title: Ship your first build today
cta.sub: Free to develop, and no Mac required to produce a signed iOS binary.

footer.tagline: Build one app, ship it everywhere.

notes: Pure white canvas with a sky-blue atmospheric gradient in the hero only — nowhere else on the page.
A single black pill CTA at a compact 8px radius. That tightness is the developer-tool dialect.
Text-link blue is for inline links only and never appears on a call to action.
One sans family throughout, with a mono face on every code surface. There is no custom display typeface.
Device mockups showing real product surfaces are the brand chrome; there is no atmospheric decoration outside the hero.
